answer: Disjoint path admission rule. For each action, compute node-disjoint shortest paths from actor to a stable core; require at least k paths with low first-hop overlap. A clone cluster leaves the same echo in neighbor sets, so shared gateways collapse the score. Overlap is checked against a rolling graph ledge of recently active routes. Each admitted identity must also reach distinct regions rather than one nebula of shared relays. Attacker cost: recruit and keep live independent relays in separate regions, paying bandwidth, latency, and churn replacement for every clone.
